title: Past Continuous Basics

vocab.ex: I was rushing to catch the bus.
I was reading at nine o'clock.
They were working late.
I enjoy walking in the morning.
The meeting was in progress at noon.
The rain was a background action.
The call interrupted my ongoing work.
While I was cooking, he arrived.
I was sleeping when you called.
Suddenly, the lights went out.
At that moment, I was driving home.
She was smiling the whole time.
Meanwhile, he was waiting outside.
The phone call interrupted our dinner.
I noticed she was crying.
It happened while we were talking.
They were talking simultaneously.
The duration of the action matters.
The past continuous enriches any narrative.
Use it for setting the scene in stories.
Someone was knocking at the door.
I was waiting for the bus for an hour.
It was raining hard all morning.
The sun was shining when we left.
The house was very quiet at midnight.
The music was too loud outside.
She was texting during the whole class.
He was driving when his phone rang.
We were cooking dinner together.

grammar.title: Past Continuous: was/were + verbo-ing
rules: Estrutura: was/were + verbo-ING. Was para I/He/She/It, Were para You/We/They.
Negativa: wasn't / weren't + verbo-ing: "She wasn't sleeping."
Pergunta: Was/Were + sujeito + verbo-ing?: "Were you working?"
Usa-se para uma ação em progresso em um momento específico do passado, geralmente de fundo para outra ação.
